description: Operational Data Connectivity is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. This dataset details the connectivity between Grid Supply Points (GSPs), Bulk Supply Points (BSPs), and their connected 132kV and 66kV feeders. There is also a limited sample of 33kV feeders and primary substations included, which should be completed in the future. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Extra High Voltage (EHV), Circuit, EHV Substation Data, New Dataset. The portal shows 2026-04-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
